授業概要
資源循環型社会に対応可能な建築構造システムの開発と、その力学特性評価及び構造設計法に関する研究。
Studying (1) development of construction methods, (2) evaluation of mechanical characteristics, (3) structural design methods and so forth, which are adoptable for recycle-oriented buildings in sustainable societies.
授業形態
（項目）
■ Presentation
■ Discussion
授業形態
（内容）
Students express each time the contents studied after last time, and discussion with a professor is carried out.
使用する教材等
Materials (paper medium), Slide materials (electronic media)
全体の教育目標
Cultivating skills needed to do develop research for structural systems adaptable in recycling-oriented buildings.
個別の教育目標
Gain the ability to understand structural systems adaptable in recycling-oriented buildings, and to formulate construction methods or structural design methods for those systems.
授業計画
Individual seminar classes will be conducted periodically. The actual lesson plan that is suitable for the student will be decided by consultation.
キーワード
Reduction of global environmental load, Sustainability, Recycling-oriented building structure, Reuse
授業の進め方
Investigating past studies, and discussion.
